capabilities: Repair invalid file names with adjustable per-character replacement rules
Update links when renaming and keep the old name as an alias
Queue doubtful renames in a review list for manual confirmation
Log every rename to per-device .jsonl files with a filterable view
Expose sanitizeName and checkName API functions to other plugins
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; installable manually or via BRAT. Renames nothing by default on phones and tablets, and automatic renaming requires Obsidian's 'Automatically update internal links' setting to be on.
problem: LLMs, scripts and other tools create files whose names contain characters Obsidian Sync rejects or that break internal links, and Obsidian does not fix them itself.

relations.evidence: fall back to the same default rules without it, through safeFileName in obsidian-kit

summary: Rule-based file name repairer that renames files with characters Obsidian Sync or links reject, logs every change, and offers a name-checking API.
